invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of execute(), which is expected to not be null in well-behaved workflows.
Method parameter preppedRecords should not be null on method exit.
Method parameter instantTime should not be null as it represents a commit instant.
The passed context should not be null since it is required for execution.
The result is an object of type HoodieWriteMetadata<List<WriteStatus>> returned from this method.
